pre_merge_pr.title: T-2484: Complete the Kinzie house, river green and poplar row
pre_merge_pr.body:
The 1812 Kinzie house now has reconstructed whitewashed squared logs and the taller pictured west doorway. Its arbitrary 39 m garden becomes a bounded 17 m fenced green, with four Lombardy poplars in a safe riverward row and both existing cottonwoods retained. Finish/date, dimensions and planting positions remain explicit liberties.

All seven original public-domain pictures and actual native before/after pairs were directly viewed. The fresh canonical house+green image gate passes seven Matches with explicit T-3153 source/date/camera disagreements preserved. The late Teich printer palette does not become evidence of an attested 1812 roof colour. Procedural trees have separate published context qualification.

Validation:

- Authenticated Ubuntu 26.04 / Blender 4.5.3 [native run 42818215260](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago/actions/runs/42818215260), retained `d6076c038f5d7e103c922110b568c3188436ec25`: exactly two changed targets; all 81 control MASTER/WEB/LOD files byte-exact with zero UV exceptions; 961 foreign defaults and six variants exact. At that native checkpoint, both target sidecars equal complete frozen owner output; final sidecars also pass the full current compiler check. Actual end-door leaf measures 0.02 m sill / 2.52 m head, 2.50 m clear; front door and horizontal door/name/placement/wall-cache fields stay exact.
- Nine desktop and nine default 390×780 phone frames plus two bounded phone supplements were directly reviewed: Normal/ByGrade house/green/door, reconstructed Source fields, credited Images and standing Liberty. Six actual planted-stem IDs/species/heights and terrain stations match source; page/console/request/response errors are zero. Desktop separates all six trees. Phone perspective/detail overlaps row crowns; no separate-phone-crown-count claim is made. Tree surfaces inherit inferred ecology; authored positions/heights remain reconstructed, without per-stem R shader proof.
- After normal current-dev integration, actual publication `16398263d5` passed two additional minimal desktop/phone boot/import/pin/six-stem/terrain checks, with one overview each. Desktop retains source Object3D geometry; default coarse phone releases/collapses it. Original fixture failures and the earlier desktop policy recovery remain preserved.
- Final source `317c7a5cff2aac14b5e2a2cad42bb0518f44f149` contains the official full-input compiler correction for existing 1835 research dossier links. Independent Git comparison verifies all 615 changes affect only that field, every dossier exists, and every native output, renderer and 1812/1904 sidecar/physical source remains exact reviewed `163`. Full actual scene/compiler and SourceUse checks pass. The official owner tail completed through step 206, with its scratch-space failure and successful resume retained. No sparse-filesystem result is presented as full-source acceptance.
- All 1,050 native recipes freshly recompute on final `317` with zero failures. Official worn-ground/land-tract owners, Lib 1,091, SourceUse 659 and meaningful door compatibility/negative controls pass. Native/source/camera/planting invariance and all literal failures are retained.

Broad native runtime coverage is **17/18 passed legs**. The old 1835 desktop13 leg hit the 40-minute cap twice without assertion failure; both logs are public. No full-18-green claim is made. Frozen-source stale derived owners have been corrected; exact-current-source protected GitHub checks remain required before ordinary dev merge.

[Target review and final-source proof packet](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/tree/2834ceb3167ef174dae20e517c223ee1905c31da/2026-11-10/T-2484-kinzie-completion-2beb73357a) preserves 22 actual screenshots, direct reviews, hashes, policy proofs and full-owner/freshness evidence. [Full native archive](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/tree/8ba8c3fd94f0f7ac9f20c8e7bc569cccc2ccda9f/evidence/2026-11-10-t2484-native-qualification) preserves all 75 original non-cache files plus metadata, with exact public readback. [Source/native/seven-picture dossier](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago/tree/steward/t2484-kinzie-house-completion-20261110/chicago/4d/docs/RESEARCH/kinzie-completion-T-2484). No new photo follow-up ticket was filed. T-2484 remains claimed pending current green checks and ordinary dev merge.
